observations: Positive control B-LOCALHOST-DIRECT: 240/240 streaming decompressions byte-identical to ground truth with 240/240 raw-byte passthrough across all 48 (payload x order x chunk x AE) cells; environment is valid so CDN inferences are licensed.

CDN main matrix: 60/240 correct. All 60 successes are GZIP-OUTER payloads fetched with client Accept-Encoding containing gzip (12 cells x 5/5). All 180 other observations fail with decoder errors, 0 transport errors.
No chunk-size effect: chunk 8192 and chunk 32 agree on every one of the 48 cells (12 cells 5/5 at both sizes, 36 cells 0/5 at both sizes).
CDN gunzips origin content when the client omits gzip: GZIP-OUTER with AE br/none is delivered as inner-brotli bytes (brotli-decodable, forensic br_dc OK) with Content-Encoding absent.

CDN always decodes origin brotli: BROTLI-OUTER is never delivered byte-identical (0/120 passthrough) under any Accept-Encoding; text types are re-gzipped when the client accepts gzip (Content-Encoding: gzip, forensic gzip_dc OK then ITER==GT); octet-stream is served as decoded inner-gzip bytes with Content-Encoding absent.

CDN silently re-encodes even when the header is unchanged: HTML GZIP-OUTER with AE gzip/both is delivered with Content-Encoding: gzip but different bytes (2752 -> 2759); the re-encoded bytes still gzip-decode to ground truth.

CDN gzip-compresses identity text payloads when the client accepts gzip (JSON 10240 -> 3999 bytes, HTML 10239 -> 2803 bytes, Content-Encoding: gzip); octet-stream identity passes through byte-identical 5/5.

Cache stability: all 6 fixed-URL triplets byte-stable across 1s-spaced reps (raw_unique=1); GZIP-OUTER triplets all-correct, BROTLI-OUTER triplets all-incorrect; cf-cache-status was DYNAMIC on all 273 CDN responses (no HIT observed).

Forensic encoding-agnostic iterative full-body decode (try brotli, try gzip until identity) recovers ground truth on 24/24 JSON/HTML CDN deliveries despite the transforms; the failure is in the fixed origin-order framing assumption, not byte corruption.
CDN median round-trip 162.0 ms (range 140.6-287.2 ms) vs localhost 0.6 ms; geographic edge for this run was sjc01 (tunnel.log).
unresolved: Whether encoding-agnostic iterative decode (shown recoverable on 24/24 JSON/HTML forensic deliveries) restores 240/240 correctness through the CDN was not executed as a frozen condition; it is the recommended next test, not an established result of this packet.
CDN-cache HIT staleness: no cf-cache HIT was observed (all DYNAMIC), so stale-cache serving behavior remains untested; a cacheable content-type/extension design would be needed.
